JsonType
public final class GetModelEventsByIdentity extends GetModelEvents
Selects Model streams explicitly by primary identity or alias, without fallback between those namespaces. The distinct wire type requires peer support. Ordinary GetModelEvents retains primary-first lookup. Alias selection is current-only; retain the returned canonical identity for subsequent pages and historical reads.
